name: Salia
source: A ParaMail rider of the First Unit and its captain after Zola's death. A very serious and hardworking soldier who is very skilled, but acts like a complete textbook example of one. She has a secret hobby of cosplaying as a magical girl from the books she reads during her free time.
translation: A ParaMail rider of the First Unit and its captain after Zola's death. A very serious and hardworking soldier who is very skilled, but acts like a complete textbook example of one. She has a secret hobby of cosplaying as a magical girl from the books she reads during her free time.
